scorer: score.py v1 — objective-first; honest_scoping is a keyword heuristic with a documented model-judge hook

live_candidates.note: two real blind candidates from the 2026-08-26 eval, scored from their on-disk sub-agent transcripts (transcript-only, evidence dirs were pruned worktrees)

interpretation: A strong verify-snippets run scores ~0.93-1.0: it discovers the skill, runs the expected lanes for the claim, stays in scope, and scopes device-only limits honestly. A run that fakes it (overclaims iOS from a sandbox, no real lane) scores <0.2. Over-triggering on a non-matching prompt scores 0.2. Hillclimb the mean of the objective criteria (discovered, executed, right_lane, over-trigger); treat honest_scoping as advisory until an independent judge model is wired in.
